output_classification.scope_limit: This establishes the actual reviewed production/continuation interfaces. An arbitrary later historical reader may still require an intent; restore its original whole bytes first.

current_dependency_review.result_scope: The published complete current warm chain starts at accepted099 and new prefix stages, followed by pulse/assembly/Hold/mode sources. It does not numerically consume these standalone historical intents. Do not extend that source-specific conclusion to arbitrary future consumers.

exact_restoration.intent: Use fixed_intent_recovery_commit:path or the explicit Git blob; verify byte length, Git blob and listed original SHA256 before consuming.
exact_restoration.parents: Use each parent's own recovery_commit/path/blob/size and exact original SHA256. The large warm/status body need not still be in current main; none is deleted or rewritten by this proposal.
exact_restoration.regeneration: If historical scientific regeneration is needed, use the complete original workflow/request and original inputs in Actions. No new calculation is required for this retention; new floating-point work is not promised byte-identical. Exact original bytes can be restored directly.
exact_restoration.raw_identity: Do not parse/reserialize JSON or decompress/recompress gzip before verifying original raw-byte identities.
exact_restoration.scientific_status: Actual workflow success/failure is not substituted for original scientific acceptance or a closed-surface certificate. All actual conclusions and unknown/failure responsibilities remain unchanged.
